The “Hua's 0.618 optimization method” was used to find out the optimum conditions when the sludge was treated with the outfields independently and orderly. It can be seen from the results that as the temperature goes high and the treating-time by the ultrasound goes long, the SCOD shows the trend of linear and exponent growth. When the two outfields affect independently, the optimum condition is 107°C by thermal and 55min by ultrasound with the raise of SCOD by 235.55% and 140.04% respectively. When the two outfields affect orderly, thermal-first shows advantage with the raise of SCDO by 337.40% to 297.71%. Meanwhile, there is no obvious difference in PH.

articleTitle: Channel Model of Sensor Signal Transmission in the Sewer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper is to resolve the problem on the credible transmission of detection signal in the sewer, in accordance with the transmission rule of signal in confined areas, the electromagnetic wave propagation in the sewer space is divided into the two different regions which are called near field and far field and giving the wave model equation of the electromagnetic wave propagation in the sewer. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the bigger conductivity, magnetic permeability, and dielectric constant in the sewer are, the smaller attenuation rate is, the higher frequency is, the smaller attenuation of electromagnetic wave in the sewer is, the bigger radius of the sewer is, more beneficial the electromagnetic waves transmit.

articleTitle: Parameterized Design of Discal Cam Mechanisms with Oscillating Roller Follower Based on Pro/E
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The traditional design methods of cam have many problems, can no longer meet the requirements of the current design of the cam. In the Pro/E's design environment, based on a mathematical analysis to establish the correct expression, to achieve cam parameterized design, and design accuracy is very high, greatly improve the design efficiency.

articleTitle: The Study of Adaptive Control of Hydraulic Generator Unit by Using GA-Improved Wavelet Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Due to the highly complex dynamics of hydraulic generator unit, it is hard to develop an accurate analytical expression of the dynamic model, a new adaptive control algorithm based on the learning characteristic of neural network and the function approximation ability of the wavelet is presented in this paper. The control system consists of two wavelet networks, one realizes active identification and another control for hydraulic generator unit. Simulation results show that this control system is more effective than those based on neural networks.

articleTitle: Simulation of Inclusions Motion and Removal in RH Refining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Steady, three-dimensional velocity fields inside the RH are obtained, then be used to predict the removal of inclusions from molten steel with the help of Fluent. Inclusion transport in RH and the influence of inclusion diameter, density and lifting gas flow rate on inclusion removal rate are discussed. It is found that inclusion removal rate varies greatly with size. Inclusions larger than 50μm are removed easier. Decreasing density causes a slight increase in the removal time of inclusions. The inclusion is easier to be removed when the density is less than 3,500 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The best lifting gas flow rate for inclusion removal is 1200NL/min.

articleTitle: Research on Inverse Control and Compound Control Based on SVM in Large Ship Boiler Steam Pressure Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The inverse model of system is constructed based on the off-line identification of SVM (support vector machine), and online SVM control is used into an approximate pseudo linear system, which is composed by the inverse model and the original nonlinear system, in order to reduce the nonlinear traits of system. In addition, a compound control of online SVM control and Fuzzy PID control is presented to compensate the inaccuracy of inverse model, and Fuzzy PID control is mainly used to realize the earlier period control for fast response request, while in-line SVM control is used to remove the steady-state error of controlled system in later period. Theoretic analysis and simulations show its validity when applied in large ship boiler steam pressure control.

articleTitle: Anaerobic Treatment of Yeast Effluent in an Expanded Granular Sludge Bed Reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate the use of an anaerobic expanded granular sludge bed (EGSB) reactor, to treat high strength yeast wastewater. The EGSB reactor was seeded with granular sludge from the UASB reactor of a full-scale brewery factory. Experiment was done under operational condition of a total superficial up flow velocity(Vup) of 6m·h-1, Temperature of 30□, COD concentration of about 20 g·L-1. Start-up of a step-wise manner was adopted. The volumetric organic loading (BV.TCOD) was increased progressively by varying flow of the influent, and extent of raising BV.TCOD should be less than 30% at each step. After the start-up period of 79 days, the BV.TCOD of the EGSB reactor reached 15.8 kg COD m-3·d-1, and obtained COD removal efficiency of 69.5%. The specific methanogenic activity of the sludge was about twice higher than that of the seeded sludge. The experimental results indicated that the anaerobic treatment of yeast effluent in an EGSB system appears to be a feasible option.

articleTitle: Analysis on Energy Efficiency and Pollutant Reductions of Direct Sewage Source Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: When using the urban sewage as cooling and heating sources of the heat pump system in the buildings, the indirect system is potential in the future. The key technologies in the direct system are discussed. With the traditional heating and cooling system as the comparisons, the direct system is analyzed on energy efficiency and pollutant reductions. And the primary energy ratio of the direct system is bigger about 0.2, annual energy conservation is approximately bigger 7% and pollutants reductions are higher about 8% than the indirect one.

Author Keywords: direct sewage source heat pump system

articleTitle: Study on Nitrite, Nitrate and Ammonia (NNA) Pollution of Goundwater in Typical Urbanization Areas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the urbanization process of Guangzhou, which was characterized by highly centered economy and fast utilized resources, groundwater environment was influenced severely. High concentration of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> in groundwater concentrated in the city center, and samples with over proof NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> distributed around the city and hilly areas, besides in the central region. Groundwater contaminations caused by human are complex. There have been various reasons for nitrite, nitrate and ammonia (NNA) pollution of the groundwater which are mainly resulted from human activities such as domestic, industrial and agricultural activities. In addition, the NNA contamination is also related to strata sedimentary features of the plain area, groundwater formation and occurrence conditions. The forms of nitrogen distribution in Guangzhou groundwater environment are affected significantly by hydrogeology conditions and hydrogeochemical factors, such as redox environment, lithology of vadose zone, recharge, runoff and discharge conditions, content of Fe and Mn in water and soil, the degree of acidification and so on.

articleTitle: Study on Spatial Panel Analysis of Inter-provincial Carbon Emissions Based on STIRPAT Model in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Spatial panel models of inter-provincial carbon emissions impact factors were established based on STIRPAT model in China. A spatial autocorrelation test of carbon emissions of each province in China from 1997 to 2007 had been done. Then, a spatial panel analysis of carbon emissions impact factors including total population, per capita GDP, and energy intensity was done. Conclusion: the activities of interprovincial carbon emissions are significantly positive correlated. Population, per capita GDP and energy intensity are highly significant effect on carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Detoxification of Wheat Straw Hydrolysis in Formic Acid Reaction System by D311 Ion-exchange Resin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Formic acid hydrolysis is widely used in lignocellulose pretreatment. However, formic acid hydrolysis wheat straw cannot be directly used as a fermentation substrate owing to various fermentation inhibitors, especially the formic acid in reaction system and released during pretreatment. Study found treatment of wheat straw hydrolysate with D311 ion-exchange resin had a good result on reduction formic acid. We investigated the influence of D311 resin content on the elimination of residual formic acid and the adsorbance of glucose. The results reveal that 22.5 g D311 resin can eliminate 94% of residual formic acid and with only 15% reduction of glucose concentration.

articleTitle: Performance of Polymer Electrolyte Membrane Fuel Cell Based on New Polymeric Ionomers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, novel polymer electrolyte membranes (PEMs) based on new sulfonated polyimides have been prepared. These polymers have structure of rigid aromatic polymer backbone and flexible aliphatic side chain terminated with sulfonic acid group. Membrane properties such as proton conductivity and single fuel cell performance are evaluated. Most of the polymeric ionomers showed high potential for application to PEM fuel cells.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Arrangements of the Support Rolls of an Amphibious Armored Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The impact between track and wheels of an amphibious armored vehicle in operation is the important reason of fatigue failure, and it will be the most complex in the steering condition. A dynamic model of an amphibious armored vehicle was established based on the ATV module of the ADAMS software. Simulations in the steering condition were carried out according to several typical arrangements of the support rolls. The simulation results show that reasonable arrangement of the support rolls would make the vertical beating of the upper side of the track and the impact between the track and the sprocket smaller, and improve the dynamic performance of the amphibious armored vehicle.

articleTitle: Establishment of Air Quality Assessment Model with Weight Based on Extension Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Combining extension engineering method with cluster analysis, the classic and limited matter elements were constructed according to air quality standards and main air affecting factors. The logical domain was extended from (0, 1)to (-∞ ,+∞), meanwhile, the quantitative analysis in the classic matter-set which only judged by Yes or No was extended to qualitative analysis, which could show the administrative level relation between the air quality factors better. By computing the weight of feature using AHP, air quality assessment model based on extension theory with varying weight was established. Not only could the new model show the whole level of air quality, but identify the main air pollution facts which exert great impact. The application in FUXIN city showed that the results between extension theory model of air quality in the evaluation ,Shanghai air quality index method and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation method were mainly corresponding to each other.

articleTitle: Simulation on Compound Action Between Deep Fault and Karst Collapse Column Take GuQiao Coal Mine as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In deep mining area, karst and fault developed, water inrush characteristic is the result of compound action between fault and karst collapse column, Discontinuous Deformation Analysis software (DDA) was used to simulate the compound action between fault and karst collapse column, The results showed that, on the one hand, the fault slip direction and scope was controlled by the column geometry form, on the other hand, the growth of fault will speed up the formation of collapse column.

articleTitle: Stabilization for Linear Non-Gaussian Systems with Communication Constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper addresses the feedback stabilization problem for linear time-invariant systems with non-Gaussian state and output noises, where sensors and controllers are connected via a noisy digital communication channel. A sufficient condition for stabilization of the unstable plant in the presence of data-rate constraints, is derived. It is found that there exists a quantization, coding and control strategy above a lower bound of data rates of the channel such that all closed-loop trajectories tend asymptotically to zero. Simulations are done to verify the obtained theoretical results.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Moderate Optimization in Cycloid Drive
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve cycloid drive design quality and speed in the complex constrained condition, we could derive to meet the constraints of the Pareto solution set by example and the particle swarm optimization algorithm for constrained multi-objective optimization. As there is objective error in engineering, on the basis of seven factors, nine levels of uniform design and the look mesh characteristics of SNR calculation, We take the most robust design as the final stage from the Pareto which the multi-objective robust design principle is in. By the analysis of the results of the program in the objective function (volume function and the modification error function) to the sensitivity of the various design variables, it concluded that the most sensitive factors of the objective function and their impact on the objective function which can be used to guide the development of tolerance and the actual processing.

articleTitle: Analysis on Servo Control of High-Quality Servo System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Design of double position regulator armed at servo driver whose main objectives are fast position and accurate tracking makes high position accuracy and following speed of system. Among them, semi closed-loop structure is adopted by inner position loop. Position sensor is connected with servo motor coaxially. Position gain can be chosen much higher, so that motor responses rapidly and system dynamics is guaranteed. Closed-loop structure is adopted by external position loop. Position sensor is installed in the executive body of worktable and steady-state position error compensation is only available. Position gain is chosen lower to ensure stability of the system. Based on analysis of the existence of positioning errors of servo motor semi closed-loop structure in the paper, a hybrid structure of position servo system is designed. Detailed analysis of the stability and following performance of double loops is completed. Finally, inner position loop consisted of alternating current servo motor drive and incremental photoelectric encoder locates in the end of motor shaft, and external position loop composed of DSP motion control card, inner loop servo system, ball screw and grating on the worktable forms three-dimensional laser processing driver device. Position control accuracy and following speed of three axes linkage table are ensured, and motion requirements for high speed and high precision of laser engraving machine is met easily.

articleTitle: The Heat Transfer Model and Performance Analysis of Fibre-Enhanced Phase Change Material
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Energy storage technology plays an important role on energy utilization system. The fibre-enhanced phase change material tightly combines fibre having good heat conduction property with general phase change material (PCM). It can improve the heat conduction performance of general PCM. Several parameters influencing the heat transfer performance of the whole heat storage system are studied here on the basis of heat transfer model in term of enthalpy theory. As results examined, the best approaches of obtaining excellent heat transfer performance of fibre-enhanced PCM are increasing NTU(heat transfer structure factor), the number of radial fibre and reducing i B (a criterion pinpointing the key component). The less efficient ways are increasing the heat conduction coefficient of fibre and the radius of fibre. This work will provide some references to how to optimally design the fibre-enhanced phase change heat storage system.

articleTitle: Study on the Deep-Treatment with Microelectrolysis-fenton Method of Middle-Stage Wastewater of Poplar PRC-APMP Pulping
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To solve the problems of the papermaking wastewater new discharge standards and reuse The microelectrolysis-fenton process has been applied to the advanced treatment of middle-stage wastewater with of poplar PRC-APMP Pulping. The effects of operational conditions such as Fe/C, pH, iron quantity, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> dosage and reaction time, have been experimental studied, subsequently the best handles technological conditions have been gained. The experimental results show that when pH is 4.0, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> dosage is 15mmol/L, Fe/C ratio 1.5, iron quantity10mg/L and reaction time 40min can make the treating effect best, the removal efficiencies of color and CODcr are 89.6% and 75.4% respectively The quality of the final water not only can completely satisfies the new discharge standard (GB3544-2008), but also the recycle requirements.

articleTitle: Developing Linear Viscous-Elastic Material Construction in ANSYS with UPFs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: ANSYS has powerful programmable capabilities, of which APDL is widely used because of its easiness, while UPFs is not so popular for its fairly difficulty and lack of reference data. However, UPFs has more advantages than APDL in such aspects as large data treatment, user-define materials, user-define failure criteria, user-define elements, linkage to ANSYS program, etc.. The linear viscous-elastic material construction is programmed with UPFs in this paper, and its validity is verified by examples and analytical solution. The verifying shows that the material behavior development with UPFs in this paper is successful, and the programming methods and experiences may be helpful for other fellows.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Tertiary Treatment on Complex Chemical Secondary Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Biochemical characteristics of chemical secondary effluent in tertiary treatment were studied with a piloted system of biological contact aerators to meet limits of national discharge. The results showed that biochemical characteristics of the secondary effluent had higher concentrations of residual COD and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N, as well as lower residual concentrations of BOD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> and alkalinity. Residual COD in the effluent consisted mainly of three parts included the non-biodegradable COD presented by organic matter of toxicity, the soluble COD presented by BOD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>, and the particulate COD presented by SS. Under conditions of most non-biodegradable COD concentration of 132.70 mg/L and less alkality of 1.50mmol/L, COD concentration was decreased less than 100 mg/L, and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N effluent concentrations were decreased from 30.44 mg/L to 14.79 mg/L, and a scientific basis of reference was provided for reforming the pulse flocculated clarifier system which can meet limits of national discharge.

articleTitle: The Technical Analysis of Geology Image Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: During the tunnel construction, as the structure of geology terrane outside of the tunnel is differ in thousands ways, also the builders' interfere and so on. These reasons made the image of the tunnel face different. Usually the flow path of one image system is to deal with the image firstly. This stage is the primary stage of image processing. If this stage is not well, the work can not go on. In order to deal with image processing in the preprocessing stage better, this paper will put forward quality evaluation of image and airspace transformation strengthen so as to made the image applicable to the analysis of image system better.

articleTitle: A Novel Embedded System of Video Capture and Transmission Applied in Remote Monitoring for Wheelchair-Bed Service Robots
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we design and implemente an embedded system of video capture and transmission, which is applied in remote monitoring for wheelchair-bed robots. In the system, on the basis of the embeded linux and S3C2410AL microprocessor, an embedded App Web 3.0 server is transplanted and a programme of video capture is designed by Video4Linux2. In order to get better compression of video data, it is optimized for the block-matching motion estimation algorithm in MPEG-4. By which, we eventually realize the video transmission through the internet with JRTPLIB.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Video Moving Target Detection IP Core
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper designs a reconfigurable video MTD IP core, which established in XUP Virtex-II Pro development system platform. The design takes System Generator for the development tool, which is a system-level modeling tool developed by Xilinx Inc, to built a reconfigurable video MTD algorithm in MATLAB/Simulink environment, which is available for the FPGA platform. Then the algorithm is solidified as the hardware structure and is achieve in the form of IP core to achieve the purpose of IP reuse. The experiment has testified that the video MTD IP core meet the purpose of hardware acceleration and real-time video MTD. During the whole algorithm development process, we don't need to understand and use RTL-level hardware description language, and gives full play to the maximum performance of FPGA-based DSP. It improves system reliability and design flexibility, and has high availability.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Acoustic Signal Detection Using Extensional Stress Wave Along the Periodic Simulated Drillstring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Drillstring acoustic telemetry is an alternative wireless transmission method to retrieve down hole data. Based on the analysis of wave modes in drill string, the longitudinal wave is determined as the transmission medium. The experimental system is established by using simulated drill string according to the analogous principles. The excitation experiments on the effects of carrier frequencies at different receiving modes, receiver positions, transmission pulse characteristics on acoustic transmission behaviors are performed in the laboratory. Then, the data transmission is tested by applying the pulse signal excitation to the length-limited simulated drill string. The results demonstrate the transmission performance under the conditions of excitation power of 1 W, transmission rate of 77 bit/s and 6.2-meter simulated drill string via low-frequency extensional waves.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Stochastic Continuous-Time Systems under Data-Rate Constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper investigates the stabilization problem for stochastic continuous-time linear systems with unknown precess disturbance, where the sensors and controllers are connected by a noiseless digital communication channel. A dynamic output feedback controller is employed to stabilize the unstable plant in the mean square sense. A sufficient condition for stabilization in the presence of limited data rates is derived. Simulation results show the validity of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Application of a Disturbance Rejection Method Based on Equivalent-Input-Disturbance on a Sealing Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presents an unknown exotic disturbance rejection method and its application on speed control of a conveyor belt system. First, the general concept of the Equivalent-Input-Disturbance(EID) is introduced, Next, based on the description of the model of a practical mechanical device, the configuration of the servo system based on EID is given, Then the designing procedure is presented and simulation result shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Crank Speed of Bush Reciprocating Cutter on Bush Cut
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Bush is one of raw material for biomass fuel in China. Crank speed is an important parameter in the design of bush reciprocating cutter. A reciprocating single blade cutting test equipment was made in this paper. One factor test was done to study its influence on maximum cutting force of bush. Other tests were done to study the interaction of cutting edge angle and crank speed, as well as sliding cutting angle and crank speed. It is found that: The crank speed has significant influence on the bush cutting force and cutting surface. There is certain interaction between crank speed and sliding cutting process.

articleTitle: Improvement of Operational Mode of Counter-Current Dissolved Air Flotation Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As a new dissolved air flotation (DAF), the countercurrent DAF (CCDAF) has been proved to overcome some limitations of the traditional co-current DAF. In this study, the operational mode of CCDAF process was improved to enhance the treatment efficiency by the step-recycle of dissolved air water. The experimental results indicated: the improved process could run steadily under higher hydraulic loading by comparison with the conventional one, when the recycle ratios were same in the two processes, the efficiency of the improved one was higher than that of the conventional one, under the appropriate operating parameters (hydraulic loading was below 17 m/h, recycle ratio was above 8%, the distance between the mobile nozzle and the inlet was within 70~90 cm, and the flow ratio of the mobile nozzle and the fixed one was within 2.5~3), the improved process had significant removal effects for turbidity and algae. So the improved CCDAF process is more advantageous than the conventional one in enhancing treatment efficiency and reducing operating cost.

articleTitle: Study on the Respirable Particulate Matter Generated from the Petroleum Coke and Coal Mixed-Fired CFB Boiler
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The dust generated from the fuel combustion is one of the important sources for air pollution. This paper has made a comprehensive research on the particulate matter generated from the petroleum coke and coal mixed-fired circulating fluidized bed (CFB) boiler. Four kinds of ash were studied including the ash from the electrostatic precipitator(ESP), the ash from the bag filter, PM10 collected at the entrance of the ESP and the export of the bag filter. The results of the analysis of particle size show that PM10 of the entrance present the three peaks distribution due to the different formation mechanisms. The chemical composition analysis was conducted to deduce the formation mechanisms based on the current PM formation theory in combustion. The result indicates that there are two kinds of micron particles found, some are fuel generated, others are limestone generated. The bigger the particles are, the more limestone generated particles can be found.

articleTitle: Development of Application Software of Principles of Selecting a Reference System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To facilitate the engineers and technicians use the principles of selecting a reference system to query and calculation, to increase efficiency, improve the accuracy of calculation, we use VC and database technology to develop a query and calculation application program of principles of selecting a reference system. Users could get a series of data about principles of selecting a reference system after they enter basic size, selected reference system of fits and the kind of fits. Welcome numerous of technical staff to promote and use.

Author Keywords: Principles of selecting a reference syst

articleTitle: Preliminery Study on Small Alga Removal by Micro-pore Ceramic Filtration and UV Radiation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To solve oceanic environment problem caused by alien species invasion of ballast water, a novel approach of micro-pore ceramic filtration and UV radiation (MPCF&UV) was prompted. This work has studied on the MPCF&UV performance on small alga removal at the flow rate of 1~9m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h. In the experiment, Chlorella Vulgaris, Nitzschia closterium, Platymonas subcordiformis were chosen as indicator organisms to mix with clean seawater as simulated ballast water. Microscope and SEM was used to analyze alga removal rates and to observe the changes in shape and structure of alga cells. The results show that higher removal percentages were obtained on all the three types of alga, and Platymonas subcordiformis was observed the highest removal rates of up to 100%. By SEM observation, it can be found that micro-pore ceramic filter (MPCF) can only ruin cell walls of the algae, and UV radiation can damage both cell walls and nucleus of the algae.

articleTitle: Thermal Treatment of Coal-Gangue: Activation and Relevant Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presents a systematic study of the thermal activation of coal-gangue and factors that influence this process under different conditions. Our samples were tested and analyzed using Differential Thermal Analysis (DTA), X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Inductive Coupled Plasma-Atomic Emission Spectroscopy (ICP-AES), Magic Angle Spin Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (MAS NMR), and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). Results indicate that the degree of coal-gangue activation varies with variations in the phase structure and coordination of aluminum at different temperatures. Coal-gangue activation is also found to be impacted by such factors as particle diameter, detention time, and cooling mode.

articleTitle: Composition and Control of an Automated Balancing Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: An automated balancing machine which can perform unbalance measurement and correction automated. It consists of measurement and control unit, mechanical base and execution unit. The function of each unit is demonstrated in detail. The equation of unbalance measurement and correction is deduced. The magnitude of rotor's unbalance and the mass need to be removed is calculated according to the equation deduced. A data acquisition and control card is used to obtain the unbalance signal and realize the automated operation. AC servo motors with high precision and fast response are used to execute the respected action. A prototype is manufactured to test the thinking. Experiments results indicate that the unbalance reducing rate at one time correction more than 95%. It is very significant to further industrial development.

articleTitle: Tower-Topology of Fuzzy Optimization Bp Neural Networks and a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fuzzy optimization neural networks combines neural networks model with fuzzy optimization model, its application must establishes fixed expression topology according to actual problem. Aiming at the experiments in which multiple stages, influence factors and treatment levels should be considered, a tower-topology is established to simulate relationships between factors and results in this paper. In the topology, useless connections must be deleted and connection weights are constrained in. Through a case study of irrigation experiments, the relationship between treatment levels and yield is presented by more precisely than a traditional model.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Reflection Characteristics of Guided Waves from Defects in Steel Wires
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The aim of this work is to develop a technique for inspecting parallel wire cables by a quantitative study of the interaction of guided waves with artificial defects in steel wires. The reflection of the L(0,1) mode from notches of varying axial extents and cross-sections in 7-mm diameter wires has been studied by laboratory experiments. Results show that the reflection coefficient of this mode around 50 kHz is a strong function of the defect axial extent, two maximum reflection coefficients occurring respectively at a defect length of about 25 percent of the wavelength and 75 percent, while a local minimum occurring at 50 percent. And the reflection coefficient is approximately linear with defect cross-section when the defect axial length is given. Results imply that the maximum and minimum reflection coefficients at many different frequencies can be utilized for sizing of the axial extent of the defect. If the defect axial extent is found, the reflection coefficient at any frequency can be used to estimate the cross-sectional area of the defect. These findings will provide a certain foundation for the detection of parallel wire cables if the reflection characteristics of guided waves in the wire bundles are similar to those in an individual wire.

articleTitle: Steady-State Model Research of Nine Degrees of Freedom for Electric Vehicle with Motorized Wheels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A Steady-State model with nine degrees of freedom primarily used in driving mode for motorized wheels electric vehicle has been developed, in which the related equations of motion and the state variables are deduced. With Matlab/Simulink software, the computer simulation model is built. The kinematics properties of the model have been studied by the simulation of constant velocity steering and accelerated steering. The validity of the model is confirmed by simulation results and lays the foundation for the dynamic characteristic research of the vehicle with motorized wheels.

articleTitle: Research on Renewal Function H(t) of General Machine Fault and It's Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To study the occurrence law of general machine operational fault, based on renewal theory, and in the premise of fault to obey Weibull distribution, the two special methods are given to determine renewal function. Using the renewal function obtained by the above methods, the optimal general machine maintenance cycle model was established which consider regular detection and diagnosis. The model are successfully used in the optimal maintenance cycle study of two type commercial vehicles,examining test results show that the model's solution is accurate and reliable. The methods given by this paper to determine renewal function have very good value in engineering application, and they are accurate and easy to use.

articleTitle: The Key Correlation Between Plastic Gear Modification and Rack Tool Tip Modification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to decrease the defects of the plastic gear design and manufacturing appears increasingly, the correlation between plastic gear modification and rack tool modification are ratiocinated based on domestic and abroad information. The question whether rack tool modification effects plastic gear modification during the manufacturing is discussed, and the maximum tooth root fillet modification theory is proposed. Finally, the trial-error theory is applied to resolve minimum tip thickness problem for small gear, which validity is verified by applying this theory on the design analysis of helical gear.

articleTitle: Application Research of Evaporative Cooling in the Waste Heat Recovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Evaporative condenser is one kind of high-efficient and energy-water saving heat exchange equipment, which has been widely applied in many engineering fields. The theory and product characteristic of evaporative condenser is introduced in this paper. A new type of the application of evaporative condenser in waste heat recovery is presented. The effect of energy saving is obvious, wide application prospect of this technology is expected.

articleTitle: A Category Theory Model for Learning and Memory of the Human Brain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Learning and memory, which are important functions of the human brain, are the foundations of thinking. Revealing the learning and memory mechanism of human brain is the core objective and main development way of the intelligent science. Improved human brain functional structure model, a memory prediction structural framework on the brain structure and function are proposed. And then we work out a human brain learning and memory algebraic method based on the proposed framework, and offer a reasonable interpretation of the learning and memory mechanism of human brain. This framework provides a formalization method for the study of human brain functional structure and the establishment of image thinking reasoning system.

articleTitle: Study on Treatment Technology of Waste Emulsion in Mechanical Processing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper studied the treatment technology of high concentration emulsion wastewater in metal machining plant. By analyzing the properties of emulsion wastewater, we used the combination process of membrane technology+Fe-C micro-electrolysis+membrane bioreactor to treat the wastewater. Through the ceramic membrane, The removal rate of CODCr can reach 95%. Fe-C micro-electrolysis treatment can improve the biodegradability of wastewater, lastly through the membrane bioreactor treatment systems, COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub> of the effluent is less than 100mg/L, which meets the requirements of The First Grade of the National Discharge Standard (GB89781996).

articleTitle: A Feature-Based Flexible Customization Method of Error Modeling for Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Error model customization for different work type of complex CNC equipments is significant to identify and compensate the errors of CNC integrated manufacturing, and further to achieve process optimization and product quality control. Traditional error modeling method is complicated, takes long time and is difficult to change itself. A flexible customized error modeling method based on feature and multi-body system (MBS) theory is proposed. Firstly, feature space of machine tool and Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) homogeneous transformation matrix space are build separately. Secondly, feature mapping function is deduced. Thirdly, customization method of error model is described. Finally, flexible customization system for error modeling based on feature is developed. Using this system and method to execute error modeling for several typical machine tools of Shenyang Machine Tool Group. It takes about 1minute to get an accurate error model. It can analyze single error's percentage of total error. These are basis of error compensation. The practices indicate the method is effective and feasible. The method provides a new thought for error control, optimization of integrated manufacturing process, digital manufacturing and automation technology.

articleTitle: Development of Portable Data-Acquisition and Signal Analysis Instrument Based on ARM and DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A portable instrument of fault diagnosis with high performance and miniature use based on ARM and DSP was developed in this paper. This system adopted the structure of dual-CPU,which can exploit the particular advantages of each CPU: DSP is good at high speed data processing, and ARM specializes in control and net communication. Its hardware configuration and software structure were described, meanwhile, the communication between the two CPUs was also studied. Finally, the gear experiment indicated the portable instrument based on ARM and DSP which completed functions of data acquisition, storage, analysis and communication, can meet the requirement of fault diagnosis and state monitoring of machine in factories.

articleTitle: Discussion of Steam Loss Prediction Methods in the Development of Oil Sand with SAGD Technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: SAGD technique is one of prospect method in situ to exploit oil sand in Alberta Canada that is the most important oil sand production area. This paper introduced the SAGD theory, production characterization in different stages and well pattern. The author analyzed the causes of steam loss in SAGD exploitation. Studied the principle of steam loss prediction and raise the classification standard of steam loss. Mud losses during the drilling of the horizontal sections of the wells, the mini troll pump test and “soaking” test with diesel in the horizontal section were tested in Athabasca L oil sand ore, analyzed the difference of the steam loss results between the above three predictions methods and actual production after regular operation. The method of mud losses during the drilling of the horizontal sections of the wells shows best match results between prediction and actual steam loss, whose cost of logging data is the lowest in these three methods. Finally, the paper discussed the possible reasons for the errors of the three methods.

articleTitle: Research on Swirler for Intake Induced Swirl in DI Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Swirl is an important flow pattern of air motion, it not only affects the fuel-air mixing and combustion processes in diesel engine, but also has a significant impact on heat transfer, combustion quality, and engine-raw emissions. For generating swirl efficiently, many researches have been performed, however, almost the methods have more or less crucial disadvantages. For overcoming these shortcomings and generating more efficient swirl during the intake process, the authors design a new device, swirler, to induce intake swirl in non-swirl intake port diesel engine. In this paper, the authors design four types of swirler including one straight-shaped swirler and three arc-shaped swirlers. In order to research the fundamental characteristics of swirler, the authors make series of experiments researches. The total researches can be divided into three stages: in the first stage, steady flow tests are carried for researching the swirl capability and the discharge capability of swirler from the macro-level, in the second stage, flow fields in the cylinder are measured by Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) technique in the water analog tests for researching the swirl performance from the micro-level, at last stage, the tested swirler is installed on a certain type of actual diesel engine for studying whether swirler can improve the engine operation performance noticeably. The results show that this new device can induces intake swirl efficiently and can improve fuel economy at on an optimized swirl ratio.

articleTitle: Compression-Disk Remanufacture Process Research (I)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The reasons for the failure of the compression disk are analyzed in detail. Based on the analysis, composite repair technology is researched and is realized by using the thin-walled parts (compression disk) remanufacturing, comprising laser cladding and restorative machining technology. It also provides reliable evidence for the future research on the cladding bonding strength and cutting surface integrity.

articleTitle: Pyrolysis of Waste Polystyrene to Recover Styrene over Alkaline Mesoporous Molecular Sieve K2O-BaO/MCM-41
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Mesoporous molecular sieve BaO/MCM-41 catalyst was synthesized under hydrothermal conditions and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-BaO/MCM-41 molecular sieve was prepared by impregnating BaO/MCM-41 with KNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The obtained K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-BaO/ MCM-41 was used in catalytic pyrolysis of polystyrene(PS). The effects of catalyst kind, content of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O, reaction temperature, pressure and time on pyrolysis results of PS were examined. The results showed that K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-BaO/MCM-41 had better catalytic performance. Under the conditions of m(catalyst)/m(PS) = 2%, temperature 410°C, pressure 0.01MPa and time 20 min, the conversion of PS was ≥98%, the yield of liquid product was ≥96% and the content of styrene in liquid product was ≥73%. The reusability of the catalyst was investigated and there was no obvious decrease in conversion of PS, yield of liquid products and content of styrene in liquid products after the catalyst was reused for 5 times. Moreover, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-BaO/MCM-41 was characterized by XRD.

articleTitle: Uncertainty of Counteracting Force at Joints and Establishment and Analysis of the Dynamic Modeling of Grippers for Large Scale Heavy Duty Forging Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper presents the concept of the Response Dead Zone of counteracting force, analyzes the changing law of kinematic pairs' counteracting forces during the operation of large scale heavy duty grippers. The dynamic equations of the gripping mechanism which takes the friction of kinematic pairs into consideration are established. On top of that, we further investigate the reasons that result in the uncertainty of the counteracting forces of kinematic pairs and the incompleteness of the mechanism dynamic model. Finally, as a conclusion, the method of the friction condition's judgment is proposed and the fiction constraint equations are established, which make the mechanism dynamic model become complete and solvable.

Author Keywords: Response Dead Zone of Counteracting Force

articleTitle: Construction and Application of ART on Personal Credit Scoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: We propose Fuzzy ART in personal credit area to the problem which can't handle discrete variables and continuous variables together and compared the outputs with logistic regression, linear programming and the BP neural network model results. The empirical result indicates that the model of Fuzzy ART category has less error II and possesses better applicable for commercial banks.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study on the Walking Hydraulic System for Tracked Nodule Collector for Sea Floor Mining on the Basis of AMESim Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The tracked nodule collector for sea floor mining is one of the key technologies for a deep-sea polymetallic nodule mining system, this paper builds a simulation model of walking hydraulic system for a tracked nodule collector on the basis of AMESim platform, a closed loop control system is constituted in the paper according to the negative feedback of the hydraulic motor angular velocity, a stimulation analysis is also made on the response characteristics of pedrail speed and motor pressure. Through the comparative study between the results of experiment and simulation, this paper verifies the validity of modeling a walking hydraulic system for tracked nodule collector for sea floor mining, manifesting that the created walking hydraulic system meets the demand of China's polymetallic nodule mining system on benthal tracked nodule collector.

articleTitle: Studies of Hydrodynamics of the Fluidized Bed Reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The hydrodynamics of a two-dimensional bed reactor were studied computationally. To describe the particulate phase stress in the Eulerian-Eulerian two-fluid model, the kinetic theory of granular flow has been used. Syamal O'Brien drag function was used to calculate momentum exchange coefficients between gas and solid phases. We specified diameter of glass beads which is 300μm and restitution coefficient which is 0.9. The boundary condition of walls was assumed as no slip. Simulation results such as flow field, distributions of velocity, volume fraction and pressure were obtained. Additional experimental studies and simulations involving chemical reactions need to be carried on.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-domain Collaborative Modeling and Simulation Techniques to Shearer Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A shearer designed by coal company’s was taken as a project object, rigid-flexible coupled models of the whole shearer were established based on multi-domain modeling and simulation technology, The technical problems about how to calculate the shearer’s loads, how to add the loads on the whole shearer and how to set the simulation solver parameters had been discussed. From the simulation results, the stress and deformation of the shearer in working condition had been predicted. Problems such as stress concentration of the shearer’s shell and planet shaft and large deformation of the planet carrier were found, and also the improvements and optimization programs were put forward after the simulation. It really gave some certain references to improve the shearer’s working reliability. At the same time this technique also provided a new way to research the reliability of shearer.

articleTitle: Application Research on Mechanical and Electrical System Fault Monitoring System Based on Sensitivity Monitoring Technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Mechanical and electrical system status monitoring and fault diagnosis technologies have received increasing attention. The traditional monitoring process can not meet the actual demand. The sensitivity monitoring technology conducts all-round monitoring of vibration vector of mechanical and electrical system as well as the vibration vector change type, increases the monitoring information amount and enhances the monitoring sensitivity. Through the monitoring and diagnosis application of the transmission gear friction and collision of some mechanical and electrical system, the efficiency of sensitivity monitoring technique has been verified.

articleTitle: A Kind of Digging Shovel of Cassava Harvester Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Through comparing and analyzing the existing digging shovel of cassava machinery, and based on the physical characteristics of soil, cassava tuber and the standard factors of the traction power, a triangular convex shovel was designed. Shovel blade angle is 106°, blade width is 100cm, shovel face tilt angle is 25°, the terminal height of shove is 20cm, shovel length is 30cm and of finger-like extension of the parameters (length is 250cm, diameter is 12mm, intervals is 10mm). By calculating the digging force of triangular shovel shows that the digging force does not exceed 6500N.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis and Control of an Energy Storage Flywheel Rotor with Active Magnetic Bearings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Flywheel energy storage is a promising technology for providing intermediate energy storage. An energy storage flywheel is supported by active magnetic bearings (AMBs) to achieve high speed running and increase energy efficiency of the energy storage system. The configuration of the flywheel rotor is complex and its rotor dynamic behavior influences the running of the AMB rotor greatly, including its strong gyroscopic effects and bending vibration modes whose frequencies are within the rotor's operation speed range. Careful dynamic analysis was performed for the flywheel rotor. Based on the analysis results, an effective controller design for the AMBs was performed. An advanced controller with local damping enhancement and cross feedback technologies was successfully designed. The controller could well restrain the negative influence from the gyroscopic effects, suppress the bending mode vibration and achieve a stable suspension of the rotor in the whole operation speed range. Experimental results were provided and proved the effects of the analysis and the controller.

articleTitle: Research on the High-Power and High-Lift Headstock Gear Based on Driving Symmetrically
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the driving symmetrically theory, the high-power & high-lift headstock gear is designed. The reel of its important part has been carried out by force analysis, and deduced out stress calculates formula of reel wall. According to the project usage condition, it reaches the design requirements.

articleTitle: Vehicle Guidance Algorithm Considering Delays at Intersections
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In urban traffic network, there is turning delays and turning prohibition etc. So it is more practical to use the algorithm considering delays at intersections than general algorithm to search optimal route. In order to save space, this paper proposes a new modified forward star storage structure, which can store road network with node turning delays. And we improve A* algorithm scientifically, road impedance differences brought by drivers' turning behavior and traffic control behavior such as turning prohibition can be reflected effectively in the process of searching optimal route. Finally, take specific road network for instance, the algorithm's feasibility is verified.

Author Keywords: New Modified Forward Star Storage Structure

articleTitle: A Study on Biogas from Anaerobic Digestion with the Distiller's Grains via Lactic Acid Fermentation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The methane production of the distiller's grains via lactic acid fermentation (shorter for the fermentation residue) was investigated, and the variable trend of pH values, alkali concentration and volatile fatty acids were examined. The results showed that: (1)The methane production rate of the fermentation residue was 146.32 mL/gTS, about equally with that of wheat straw and sunflower plate, which comparatively adapt to anaerobic digestion. (2)The trend of alkali concentration and pH values was just opposite to that of volatile fatty acids(VFA) concentration. An attempt of controling pH values by controling alkali concentration achieveing controling volatile fatty acids(VFA) concentration was feasible, to avoid excessive of volatile fatty acids and to insure successfully of anaerobic digestion.

Author Keywords: the residue of distillers' grains via lactic acid fermentation

articleTitle: Study for Technology of Asphalt Pavement Aggregate Washed by Cycle Limewater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Technology of asphalt pavement aggregate washed by cycle limewater was put forward for the first time in this paper. Before and after the aggregate was washed by cycle limewater, aggregate mud content, aggregate asphalt adhesion and asphalt mixture water stability were tested. Test results showed that the aggregate mud content was reduced, and that the aggregate asphalt adhesion and the asphalt mixture water stability were all enhanced. At the same time, asphalt pavement construction energy consumption and CO2, SO2 gas emissions were all reduced by this technology. Therefore, the technology of asphalt pavement aggregate washed by cycle limewater was conducive to environmental protection and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Study of Inherent Safety Mine Hoist Based on Modern Design Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As a modern security design, Inherent Safety means that equipment and facilities is able to contain the inherent fundamental features to prevent accidents. Mine hoist is the most important equipment in the coal production. How to achieve safe, reliable, efficient production, has been the focus study at home and abroad. Inherent safety is reflected in hoist design, primarily through the design measures to improve the operation of hoist safety and reliability. In this paper, Inherent Safety theory is applied in the design of mine hoist, to proposed the design method by using the software of PRO/E,PLC, Lab view etc.

articleTitle: The Preparation and Property of Few-Layered Graphene/Benzalkonium Chloride Composite
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to research and development a novel antibacterial material which is used to deal with the drinking water, few-layered grapheme/benzalkonium chloride composite was prepared by introducing different content of quaternary ammonium salt into layered graphene, and the resulting composites were characterized by the FTIR, XRD, TGA and TEM. And minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) was used to investigate antibacterial activity. The FTIR, XRD and TEM data show that benzalkonium chloride is intercalated into layered graphene. Combined with low cost, such materials should have wide application to drinking water treatment.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Properties of Novel Post Cross-Linked Sulfonated Poly (arylene Ether sulfone)s for Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A series of novel cross-linked sulfonated poly(arylene ether sulfone)s were prepared. The membrane performance were significantly improved after cross-linking treatment, for example, the cross-linked membranes showed lower water uptake and lower swelling ratio than the corresponding original ones. With the increase of cross-linking extent, the water uptake and dimensional change decreased, while reasonably high proton conductivity was maintained.

articleTitle: A Metropolis Criterion Based Fuzzy Markov Game Flow Controller for High-Speed Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For the congestion problems in high-speed networks, a Metropolis criterion based fuzzy Markov game flow controller (MFMC) is proposed. Because of the uncertainties and highly time-varying, it is not easy to accurately obtain the complete information for high-speed networks. In this case, the fuzzy Markov game, which is independent of mathematic model, and prior-knowledge, has good performance. It offers a promising platform for robust control in the presence of the bounded external disturbances. The Metropolis criterion can cope with the balance between exploration and exploitation in action selecting. Simulation results show that the proposed controller can learn to take the best action to regulate source flow with the features of high throughput and low packet loss ratio, and can avoid the occurrence of congestion effectively.

articleTitle: The Adsorption Characteristic of Heavy Metals from Electroplating Wastewater on delta-MnO2 / Polymeric Ferric Sulfate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The work investigated that δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> / Polymeric ferric sulfate (PFS) treated on electroplating wastewater containing heavy metal ions Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>. Effect adsorption on the pH, the amount of adsorbent, the input order and ratio of δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> / PFS, the research determined the laboratory simulated electroplating wastewater treatment process and other basic parameters. The results showed that the best acidic conditions was pH = 7 ~ 8, and δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> combined with PFS adsorption on heavy metals of wastewater with Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> was better than the single use of δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and PFS, δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>: PFS for the 3:1 quality ratio, the first dosage of δ-MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> stirring for half an hour then plus PFS mixing 2 hours, the heavy metal ions Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> from wastewater in the removal rate of 98.8%, 98.1% and 99.3% ion concentrations were lower than 1.0 mg / L. The results were in line with the national emission standards.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics Rebuilding of HIL Simulation System and Its Validation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the fundamental problems on the system design of the Hardware-In-the-Loop (HIL) simulation. Through analyzing the simulated object system and the HIL simulation system for on-orbit docking dynamics, the design problem of HIL simulation system is defined as a rebuilding problem of the dynamic characteristics of the HIL simulation system. This idea provides the solution to the system design problem of HIL simulation. Finally, a experimental system is setup with above idea, and the test results verified the correction of above ideas.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance and Emission of a Port Fuel Injection Hydrogen Internal Combustion Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A 2.0L nature aspirate gasoline engine was modified to port fuel injection (PFI) hydrogen internal combustion engine (HICE) and a series dynamometer tests were carried out. The in-cylinder combustion process was analyzed, the performance, thermal efficiency and emissions of HICE with various mixture eqivalence ratios was summarized. The experimental results showed: While 20~25% lower torque compared with gasoline is observed for this naturally aspirated hydrogen engine, peak efficiencies of 45 % were achieved with brake thermal efficiency above 30% over a wide range of operating conditions. NOx emission was quite a little when the mixture equivalence ratio lower than 0.55 or higher than 1. NOx emission reached peak level at equivalence ratio between 0.8 and 0.9. Finally the hydrogen engine was installed in a vehicle and the vehicle emission fully satisfied the Euro VI emission standard.

articleTitle: A Super High-Quality Roller Automatic Comprehensive Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The super high-quality roller is an important part in the roller and clearer card to improve the textile quality, and it should be possessed higher quality in diameter error and straightness and be required to measure on-line. A super high-quality roller automatic comprehensive measuring system had been proposed in this paper according to the relative two sensor method, and the system can perform the measurement of 7 sections' diameter error, straightness, length error and two end face's run-outs on the super high-quality roller, with the measuring time shorten to 25s, and distinguish the reject part from the detected parts, which had been applied in the super high-quality roller manufacturing pipeline. Two measurement results to the on-line multiple sample 50 parts randomly can coincide better between manual operations and the automatic comprehensive measuring system.

articleTitle: Study on Direct Kinematic Solution for Parallel Robots with 6 Freedoms Based on Interval Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A new numerical method based on interval analysis is presented for direct kinematic solution for parallel robots. After the interval function is built, the initial search box can be gained through interval analysis, which will be tested and bisected until all of the convergent intervals are obtained. Then, the classical iterate method is employed to get all the point solution in each interval.

articleTitle: Assessment for Environmental Health of Small-Scale Water Supply Source Based on Triangular Fuzzy Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Employing the triangular fuzzy technology, the article establishes a health risk assessment model for small scale water supply source. By using this model not only the value of probable risk indexes of specific substance influencing people's health but also their corresponding membership degrees (or relative confidence levels) can be obtained. The model is applied to assess the environmental health risk of the small-scale water supply source in South-west of China. The result shows : the cancerous risk indexes caused by As and the total risk reach 2.01~4.05 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>a-1 and 2.19~4.14 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>a-1 respectively, exceeding the acceptable levels recommended by ICRP(5.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>a-1); the non-cancerous risk indexes caused by all pollutions are 1.58~3.36×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>a-1, less than the acceptable levels recommended by ICRP. The research shows that it is feasible to assess water health risk by the triangular fuzzy technology.

articleTitle: The Research and Realization of the Ultra-low and Constant Speed Control Technology About the Cylinder for the Large Caliber Pipe Bender
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The ultra-low and constant speed control is one of the key techniques that the large caliber pipe bender can use to achieve bend automatic process. This technology which could analyze the working requirements of the pipe bender's heating, introduces the single-cylinder pulling and bending driving form and uses the hydraulic control technique to realize the stationary and reliability in the cylinder's ultra-low speed motion. Additionally, it will prevent the phenomenon of vibration and arc ridging in the process of thin-wall pipe's bending and assures a high quality of large bend caliber pipes with different bending radiuses and bending angles. At the same time, this technology could also be promoted and applied in any hydraulic controlled devices which need a stable and low-speeding operation.

articleTitle: Based on ADAMS Simulation of ATV Motorcycle Initial Acceleration and Climbing Ability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Against the existing matching performance that it's not reasonable of ATV motorcycle design, and the ATV's UG model was imported ADAMS and added the required constraints after set up the tire model and pavement file, the performance of ATV motorcycle initial acceleration and climbing ability was simulated by virtual prototyping technology. The results show that ATV motorcycle has good start to accelerate capability on the snow road. When the torque of the pulse is inputted, the speed can still maintain good stability, grade ability is only around 30%. Therefore, the simulation results are consistent with the actual situation, it is shown that the model established and constraints added are correct. This study lays a solid foundation for the study of subsequent speed variation and steering simulation and optimization, provides a reference for similar study.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Fine Blanking on Plane Blankholder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fine blanking process on plane blank holder utilizes three tooling elements: a punch, a plane blank holder and an ejector to generate a highly compressive stress state and pure shearing forces to constraint the deformation of sheet metal within the narrow blanking clearance zone. Numerical simulation of fine blanking for steel 20 was performed using commercial FEM software DEFORM, and element deletion technology was used to model the initiation and propagation of crack. Besides, Normalized Cockroft&Latham ductile fracture model was taken into the prediction of the quality of shear surface. Material flow analysis was investigated with the respect to the blank holder and ejector force, and the influence of process parameters such as blanking clearance and die edge radius on shear surface was discussed in this paper. Thus, effect of blank holder and ejector forces on the material flow characteristics, the relationship between the process parameters and burnish zone ratio are revealed, which may be helpful to the development of fine blanking.

articleTitle: Techniques of Polarization State Control for Interferential Distributed Optic-Fiber Sensing System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the long distance distributed optic-fiber sensing system, the polarization state of output light tends to drift, which influences the sensing system interference effect. Aiming at the typical Mach-Zehnder distributed optic-fiber leak detection system, analyzes theoretically the influence of polarization degradation on the system performance, elaborates the technologies using the PDR and FRM to control the polarization state. Simulation results indicate these two technologies can achieve good effect of polarization control.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm of Detecting Communities by Topological Centrality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Community structure is an important common property of complex network which has much theoretical significance for analyzing structure, mastering function, detecting implicit scheme and predicting activities. This paper reviews some popular detecting community methods. NTCDC Algorithm is proposed by analyzing weigh of nodes' and edges' TC values. The algorithm not only improves the precision, but also faster than GN and fast algorithm proposed by Newman. This paper demonstrate that the algorithm is higher effective and faster at discovering community structure in both computer-generated network and real-world network data than GN and fast algorithm.

articleTitle: The Application of Float-Encoding Genetic Algorithm in Optimizing Parameters of Fuzzy Controller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper presented a method of optimizing the parameters of fuzzy controller based on float-encoding genetic algorithm. Research on the efficiency of float-encoding was demonstrated. The results of simulation indicated the high efficiency of float-encoding genetic algorithm in multi-parameter optimizing.

articleTitle: Dynamic Impacts on Energy Intensity from Energy Price, Technological Progress, and ICT Investment Changes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the dynamic impacts on energy intensity from energy price, technological progress, and ICT investment changes based on comparable Input-Output table series using Tran slog cost function. We conclude that energy price change has essential impacts on energy intensity. Induced technological progress also can save energy. Along with time going, the investment adjustment will be attenuated.

articleTitle: Research on Tool Failure Mechanism of PRMMCs with Ultrasonic Assistance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, the experimental research on the tool failure mechanism using YG6 and PCD tool cutting Particular Reinforced Metal Matrix Composites (PRMMCs) with ultrasonic cutting and common cutting was carried out, and it was discovered that: (1) the tool wear of ultrasonic cutting is less than that of common cutting, the cutting speed and feed speed have greater effect on tool wear and the cutting depth has little effect on it, the tool wear decreases with the increase of cutting speed and feed speed, and with the reduction of cutting depth, (2) the wear of PCD tool is about 1/10 of YG6's with ultrasonic cutting the same distance, this is very similar to common cutting, (3) the modality of tool wear mainly shows the rake face wear, the flank wear and the tool breakage. When the distance of the cutting is short, the crater wear is not obvious on the rake face of YG6 tool, and the flank wear appears reverse triangle near the tip of tool under the two cutting ways. The PCD tool find no significant wear, but a serious tipping, (4) the tool wear of ultrasonic cutting is mainly abrasive wear, but it is weaker than that of common cutting, this is an important reason why the ultrasonic cutting can reduce the tool wear.

articleTitle: Resin Vacuum Casting System for LED Screen
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper mainly describes the resin vacuum casting system for LED screen which uses thin film degassing technology and meter mix technology. Thin film degassing technology is currently the most effective method. In this paper, we describe in detail its working model. And meter mix dispensing technology integrates metering pump and mixing pump. It mixes materials according to the demand. Therefore, the mixture is fresh always and does not cure in mixer.
