At the same time, there is no waiting time. It has excellent infiltration, thus facilitating to automatic operation. Experimental results show that this system effectively solve the bubble phenomenon and heterogeneous mixture.

articleTitle: Research for Constitutive Relationships of Metallic Rubbers with Various Structural Parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Static experiments were made for hollow cylindrical metallic rubber. Through parameter identification and curve fitting, for the three conditions in which only densities are various, only shape factors are various, and densities and shape factors are both various, respectively, theoretical prediction equations of constitutive relationship of metallic rubber were obtained. The three theoretical prediction equations were compared with each other. It showed that theoretical prediction equations in the case of various densities and shape factors had universe applicability. Theoretical prediction equations for the two conditions in which only densities are various, and only shape factors are various are special cases of that for the condition of various densities and shape factors.

articleTitle: Agent Group Based Modeling of the Complex Cooperative System on Railway Daily Dispatching Plan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the development of informationization in different application fields, establishment of the complex cooperative human-computer cooperative information system has become the focus now. The key to the problem is to build corresponding complex cooperative problem solving model. The blackboard model based on agent group is an efficient technique to build the model of certain types of complex cooperative problem existed in some application fields such as process control and group decision-making and so on. It is also suitable for the modeling problem of the complex human-computer cooperative making information system about daily dispatching plan in the field of railway dispatching and commanding in China. The paper is devoted to establishment of cooperative model. The human-computer cooperative model is provided and discussed in details according to the brief introduction of the blackboard modeling based on agent group and the complex cooperative making problem about daily dispatching plan in the paper.

articleTitle: Study on Fractal of Silt Floc Pores and the Settling Character of Silt Floc
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A new method, using fractal dimension of silt floc pores to study the settling performance of silt floc, was put forward. Firstly, the fractal characteristics of silt floc pores were descried qualitatively by the software of image-pro plus6.0, which was taken from Shahu Lake in Wuhan city. Secondly, two-dimensional fractal dimension of silt floc pores was calculated by image analysis. At last, the settling velocity of silt floc was estimated by the fractal dimension of silt floc pores, which compared with the traditional method. The conclusion given in this paper showed that porosity of silt floc may be reflected by the fractal properties, and the settling velocity of silt floc reduced with the fractal dimension of silt floc pores increasing.

articleTitle: The Research of a Equipment for Detecting and Monitoring Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the automated machinery manufacturing system, In order to improve the quality of work piece and assurance the normal operation of the working system, we often need to examine and monitor the process of the working and condition of the system. Author uses mathematical statistic analysis principle and design an equipment which can measure the work piece size in real time and control the working process by itself. By using this equipment, we can control the quality of the work piece, decrease the rate of waste products, increase the efficiency of machine work, improve the stationeriness of working process. In this article, we describe and introduce the working principle of the equipment for detecting and monitoring process, and show the specific implementation of the programme.

Author Keywords: process engineering of detecting and monitoring

articleTitle: The Research of MAS Dynamic Cooperation Model Based Role
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper based on summarizing traditional several cooperation models, present a kind of MAS (multi- Agent systems) cooperation model based role (dynamic cooperative model, DCMBR). This paper introduces role notion to DCMBR, host-Agent decompounds the task, utilizes the role information library, search the appropriate Agent, makes up to a dynamic union, then realize MAS cooperation by task allocation mechanism, completes specific task.. We apply DCMBR model to the team design of robot football emulation game, get the anticipant effect.

articleTitle: Effect of Thermal Properties of Building Glass on Cooling Energy Consumption of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Taking an office building in Guangzhou, China as example, the building environment simulation software DeST-c is used to study the effect of thermal properties of building glass on the cooling energy consumption. The results show that decreasing the shading coefficient of building glass can significantly reduce the cooling energy consumption. However, the heat transfer coefficient of building glass has little effect on the cooling energy consumption. The mechanism of the reduction of cooling energy consumption caused by the decrease of the shading coefficient is also discussed through hourly analysis on the cooling energy efficient rates all the year round.

Author Keywords: hot summer and warm winter zone

articleTitle: Roles of Tropical Indian-Pacific Oceans SSTs in the Interdecadal Variability of East Asian Summer Monsoon: A Modeling Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This study investigates the roles of tropical Indian-Pacific oceans SSTs in the interdecadal variability of East Asian Summer Monsoon (EASM) during the second half of the twentieth century based on simulations from an atmospheric general circulation model, NCAR CAM3 (Community Atmospheric Model). These simulations are conducted by the observed 1950-2000 monthly SSTs in the tropical Indian-Pacific oceans, tropical Indian Ocean and tropical Pacific, independently. Results show that CAM3 is able to simulate the observed interdecadal weakening of EASM occurred in the mid-late 1970s when SSTs in tropical Indian-Pacific Oceans and tropical Pacific SSTs are determined, but to simulate the interdecadal strengthening of EASM when SSTs in the tropical Indian Ocean are determined. These results indicate that SST anomaly in the tropical Pacific plays a central role in the interdecadal weakening of EASM occurred in the mid-late of 1970s, while SST anomaly in the tropical Indian Ocean plays a converse role in it. As a background, the interdecadal variation of tropical Pacific SSTs has an important effect upon the interdecadal weakening of EASM.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Multi-point Water Temperature Measurement and Control System for Thermal Discharge Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It is introduced in this paper that a system of multi-point temperature measurement and control has been designed in advanced technology of computer and industrial control area for thermal discharge model test. Digital temperature sensors in “1-wire bus”, digital circuit modules, standardized products XFC components and functional circuit module are applied in hardware of the system. Object-oriented approach is adopted in software designing and programming. C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup>6.0 and AutoCAD are used in measurement procedures and data processing for easily operation and real time measurement. From a number of applications on model test study for water environment near power plants in the Yangtze River, it is shown that the measurement is satisfactorily precise and reliable, meeting the requirements of design and test. The practical system in advanced technology and related equipment can be used in any place where water temperature monitoring is possible and necessary, such as rivers, lakes, reservoirs, canals or swamp water environments.

Author Keywords: water temperature measurement and control system

articleTitle: Wear Mechanism of Coated Tool During High Speed Machining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A methodology based on high speed cutting experimental test and observational methods for analyzing wear course of coated tool in milling cast iron and quenched and tempered 45 steel by coated cemented carbide inserts is introduced. The applied coatings were TiCN and TiAlN films. The geometrical model of coated tool abrasion is offered and analyzed all possible abrasion morphology of coating. Stress distributed state graph and curve of temperature versus distance from cutting edge were obtained for analysis of coated tool wear mechanism. The milling investigations were conducted at various cutting speeds and feed rates. Through analysis about the impact of cutting speed and feed on roughness, a sufficient correlation of coatings' impact resistance at various temperatures with their cutting performance at corresponding cutting speeds and feeds was revealed.

articleTitle: Research on Advanced Treatment and Reuse of Anti-counterfeiting Paper Mill Wastewater by CMF and RO Treatment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A pilot-scaled continuous membrane filtration (CMF) and reverse osmosis (RO) integrated technique was used for the treatment of secondary sedimentation tank effluent in an anti-counterfeiting paper mill, and the effluent of the integrated technique can be reused in multiple production processes. The results showed that the CMF effluent met all the requirements of RO influent, the average CODCr was 45 mg/L, turbidity was less than 0.5 NTU, SS was less than 1 mg/L, and for the CMF system the removals of CODCr, turbidity and SS were 10%, 99% and 100%, respectively. The RO effluent met the water quality requirements of papermaking in every aspects, i.e. the average CODCr was 2 mg/L, the removal rate of CODCr was bigger than 90%, the conductivity was less than 10 μs/cm, and the desalination rate was bigger than 99%. The quality of the treated water met the requirements of the anti-counterfeiting papermaking process.

articleTitle: An Application of Real-Time Engine Model in HILS Simulation and Testing Platform Based on SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Engine model is one of the most important part in HILS for ECU testing. There are shortages in normal ones, such as big framework and complex structure of software design which result in the immense calculated amount, disadvantage of hardware drive ability and bad real-time as well. In this article, the strong simulation function of MATLAB/SIMULINK was used. Engine model was built based on the mean value model, parameters involved was recognized. The comparison between simulation and bench test validation shows that the engine model could simulate at all working condition. The relative error of test result is less than ±3% in steady operating conditions, and ±6% in transient operating conditions. Which meets the demand of the application for HILS.

articleTitle: Management Measures of Improving Water Resources Utilization in Guangxi Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: by analyzing the use of water resources situation in Guangxi Power Grid, many deficiencies of the hydropower resources in Guangxi are existed, such as rich but with low development, big gap between peak and valley of power load, the inadequate capacity of power peak modulation, weak power network structure and uneven distribution of power, disorderly development of small hydropower, unreasonable distribution of hydropower station, and so on. Based on comprehending advanced domestic and international water management methods and technical measures and combining with the actual water resources situation in Guangxi Power Grid, it's suggested to improve utilization of water resources in Guangxi Power Grid by several technical measures and integrated management, including reinforcement of the hydro meteorological forecasting accuracy, adapting cascade optimal operation and compensation operation in cross river basins, dynamic control limited flood water level in hydropower station Yantan, the joint flood gates peak-shaving between Yantan and Dahua, sale-promotion power price with low load valley during flood season, water-saving operation method, standardized operation and management of small hydropower, construction of pumped-storage hydropower. All of the measures will provide technical support for energy conservation and economic dispatching of the Guangxi Power Grid.

articleTitle: An Automatic System for Clip Turning with Pneumatic and PLC Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: An automatic system for clip turning operation is developed in a company, which consists of a CKM6125 NC lathe and a series of mechanisms, designed to be driven by PLC-controlled pneumatic cylinders. This system in operation fulfils the production requirements of the company with reliable and stable performances and reduces working intensity and hidden safety troubles.

articleTitle: Frequency Measurement Using Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To realize accurate measurement of frequency, a new method based on dynamic measurement used for frequency measurement is proposed. According to the dynamic measurement value of waveform peak of signal is obviously greater than that of maximum point caused by noise, one can detect the number of main dynamic measurement of signal in a certain period of time, and calculate easily the signal's frequency. Simulation demonstrates it is a simple and effective measurement method with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Saving Lighting of Classroom Based on Cirtopic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The study of energy saving lighting in the classrooms aliases on the pupil area comparing coefficient K (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>), the luminance contrast coefficient based on pupil change R (L)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, It is shown that, to achieve the same visual performance (with the equal pupil area), 6500K and 4000K color temperature fluorescent lamps are needed to generate less luminance than 2700K, and also save more energy. Therefore, the appropriate color temperature light source is concerned with energy saving lighting in classrooms.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Special Hybrid Intelligent Power Module Based on Thyristor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at various problems of capacitor devices in low-voltage reactive power compensation, a concept of SHIPM(Special Hybrid Intelligent Power Module ) based on thyristor was proposed. This design used for reference of the integrated technology of IPM(intelligent power module) to improve the reliability level. The optimized control circuit, driving circuit, protective circuit, thyristor and high-powered magnetic latching relay were packaged in whole,as appropriative intelligent power module. The module used the parallel connection of the thyristor and magnetic latching relay in the main loop and enabled the thyristor and relay to work cooperatively through the control circuit of single-chip ATMEGA8L. First the thyristor was conducted when the voltage crossed zero. Then as a result of the close of the magnetic latching relay, the electric current was taken on by the magnetic latching relay alone. The module has the advantages of low power consumption, low surging current, strong capability of the anti-harmonic, quick response speed and high reliability. In the test of switching 30Kvar capacitance, the surging current was about 1.1 times the peak value of stable current,and the rise of temperature was smaller than 18 degree centigrade. The paper described the construction, basic principle, and performance of the circuit, and analyzed the performance of the circuit.

articleTitle: Biomass Characteristics Analysis of Compression Forming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the analysis of extrusion mechanical model of the process of flat molding extrusion form roller to the material, the relationship between axial compressive stress, radial compressive stress, tangent friction force and the length of die hole is derived, and the theoretical computation formula of radius ratio of roller and flat die is also derived. It shows effects of friction coefficient, die hole radius and Poisson ratio on the degree of saturation pressure. The paper analyses on the stress of roller in one case of radius ratio. The results from the analysis reveal that the stress mainly concentrates on the area near the center of the roller and the inner part closing the center of flat die, which can guide the basic design about the flat molding extrusion.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on the Effect of Pilot Injection on Combustion and NOx Emission Characteristics of Light-Vehicle Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on KIVA-3V code, the numerical simulation on the combustion process and NOx emission of a light-vehicle diesel engine is carried out, using different injection strategies. The results show that compared with the traditional single injection, pilot injection can decline the ignition delay period and the maximum combustion temperature, which leads to the reduction of the NOX emission, as pre-injection mass increases, NOx emission increases. Fuel of pilot injection must be sufficient for preheating the combustion chamber. Otherwise, NOx emission is deteriorated in the condition of excessive amount of pilot injection. For the light-vehicle diesel engine investigated in this paper, when the proportion of pre-injection mass to cycle-injection mass is 2.5% and the angle between pilot injection to main injection is 15°CA, the NOX emission declines nearly 21.8%.

articleTitle: The Cause Analysis Model of Pseudo Solder for Chip Component
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A cause analysis model of pseudo solder for chip component is presented. Based on analyzing the causes of the chip pseudo solder, an comprehensive equation, which is composed of an ellipse equation and a circle equation, is used to fit the surface shape of chip solder joint. On the basis of that, the chip pseudo solder model is presented. All the parameters of the chip pseudo solder model are effected by the surface mounted technology process, such as solder paste printing process, mounting processing, reflowing process and so on. Experiments results show that the surface shape of the chip solder joint is fit effectively by the comprehensive equation. Experiments results also show that parameters of the chip pseudo solder model can illustrate the cause of pseudo solder effectively.

articleTitle: The Design of a Simple Laser Shaft Alignment Instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A laser shaft alignment based on single LD-PSD was designed in this paper. And the system's mathematic model was built. The laser shaft alignment can realize automatic continuous measurement. The measurement system is very simple, useful and inexpensive. The model machine testing shows the measuring precision, reliability and anti-jamming ability are higher than like product. It can meet the requirement of coaxiality measuring in shafting.

articleTitle: Effects of Defects on the In-plane Dynamic Energy Absorption of Metal Honeycombs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The in-plane dynamic energy absorption of metal honeycombs with defects consisting of missing cells are analyzed using explicit dynamic finite element method. Two types of structural defects (a single defect located in the center of the model and a double defect) are firstly introduced. Then the influence of the defects and the impact velocities on the energy absorption abilities of metal honeycombs is investigated. Researches show that single and isolated defects reduce the absorbed energy of cellular materials. The separation distance between two defects has little effect on the dynamic energy absorption, while the size of the single defect has great influence on it. These results will provide some useful guides for the safety evaluation and the dynamic energy absorption design of metal honeycombs.

articleTitle: Selective Purchasing Optimization of Raw Materials for Refined Copper Strip by BFO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at improving the efficiency and scientificity of raw materials purchasing for refined copper strip producing, a multi-objective optimization model is established, the model is transformed by introducing some constraints into the objective function. For the raw material purchasing problem of refined copper strip, the encoding system of BFO algorithm is designed, and the tumble direction in conventional BFO algorithm is adapted so as to ensure bacteria swim feasible location each time. Thereby, the detail implement steps of BFO algorithm are designed. By the practical instance application of raw material purchasing problem of refined copper strip, the validity of above optimization model and BFO algorithm for the complex optimization model such as raw material purchasing problem of refined copper strip is validates.

articleTitle: Emergy Analysis for Circular Economy Utilization System with Coal Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper dealt with the application of emergy analysis to system with coal industry, and it presented new emergy index system to evaluate the characters and sustainability of circular economy utilization system with coal industry quantitatively. The Sitai Mine of DaTong coal mine Group Company in Shanxi, as a case, was analyzed by means of emergy analysis. The result shows that new emergy indices are practical in evaluating sustainability of coal circular economy utilization systems, which are verified good benefits and provides scientific basis for sustainable development of coal industry.

articleTitle: An Architecture of CAD/CAPP Integrated System for Wire Harness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Wire harnesses are the main parts of automotive electrical system, and they are becoming more and more complex with the improving of people's demand for the performance of safety, comfortableness, economy and emission etc. Most of domestic wire harnesses-manufactured enterprises still adopt traditional manual methods in design and process planning. Even though the design systems for wire harness have been researched deeply at abroad, they are not fully suitable for domestic enterprises, and they are quite expensive to the common company. So, it's significant to research and develop CAD/CAPP systems for wire harness. This paper proposed an architecture of CAD/CAPP integrated system for wire harness, and studied the key technologies including the method of making information model of harness, the algorithms of process planning and process database design to provide a foundation for future research and development.

articleTitle: Geodesic Connected Graph Representation of 3D Prismatic CAD Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A novel local shape descriptor, geodesic connected graph, is proposed for the representation of three-dimensional (3D) prismatic CAD model represented by triangle meshes. First, the model is segmented using the extended Gaussian image. Second, the segmented areas which are visual from certain direction are connected by geodesic lines. Finally, a geodesic connected graph of feature areas is constructed according to the path of these geodesic lines. The geodesic connected graph is a shape descriptor of local features on model surfaces, and can be used in several CAD model analysis tasks, e.g. reverse engineering, manufacturing feature recognition, and model retrieval. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective for 3D CAD model retrieval.

articleTitle: Online Optimization Software Development of 600MW Steam Turbine Cold-End Based on SIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve the economy of thermal power unit cold-end system, considering variable performance of condenser, circulating water pump, variable frequency speed regulation, and driving motor, it is proposed to establish a cold-end optimization model for 600MW super-critical unit based on SIS. The technology of offline calculation, online interpolation is applied to develop the operating optimization software of cold-end, which can reduce computer’s calculating process greatly and is of good stability, real-time performance and practical value.

articleTitle: The Research on Embedded Parallel Machine Tool Based on an Open Numerically Controlled Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper compares the characteristics of the numerically controlled systems of the parallel machine tools and the traditional ones. Based on an open numerically controlled platform, a method of developing the numerically controlled system of a parallel machine tool is proposed. So long as the numerical program is embedded into a mature numerically controlled platform as a functional module through a standard interface, the general function of the platform could be shared. Finally, we take a 5-strut-5-dof parallel kinematic machine tool, which is developed by ourselves, as an example. On the basis of EMC open numerically controlled platform, an inverse mathematical model is embedded into the parallel kinematic machine tool. After recompiling, a correct result is got. Thus we conclude that it is a fast, low-cost and very efficient method. The idea and methodology could also be applied to other numerically controlled systems of parallel machine tools.

articleTitle: Central Pattern Generator Based Control of a Roller-Skating Robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A bionic control method for a roller-skating robot locomotion is presented. The control system consisted of a high level controller and a central pattern generator(CPG) neural network. Each CPG is modeled as a modified Hopf nonlinear oscillator with frequency, amplitude and bias can be controlled individually. By changing the parameters of CPGs and connection weights between CPGs, the robot can realize multimodes locomotion of straight line skating and steering with different speed and direction. Furthermore, the control system can perform smooth transitions between different locomotion modes. The effectiveness of the proposed method is confirmed by simulation.

articleTitle: The Design and Computerized Simulation of High Tooth Contact Ratio of Face Gear Drive with Helical Pinion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A face gear drive with high contact ratio and good dynamic performance are considered. A novel approach is developed for design of high contact ratio based on the path of contact is oriented longitudinally, which can be accomplished by application of profile crowing for helical pinion and face gear tooth surfaces. The amplitude of loaded transmission errors that generate vibrations and noise are made by design of parabola coefficient a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p1</sub> of tool plunging and parameter of parabola apex u<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>. The coefficient η<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> has been introduced as the simultaneous pairs of meshing teeth in order to calculate the contact ratio in a meshing cycle. Three techniques are considered in the paper: local synthesis, tooth contact analysis (TCA) and loaded tooth contact analysis (LTCA). The developed theory is illustrated with numerical examples. The results confirm that a gear drive with minor transmission errors and contact ratio to be about 3.0 or higher could be obtained.

articleTitle: The Design of the Monitoring Circuit for the Rocket Ignition Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In ignition process of the space rocket engine, design of the monitoring circuit is very important. If the monitoring circuit can not reliably work, separation of the rocket engine will be greatly affected, thereby the safe ignition of the rocket engine will be affected. In this paper, aiming at the real problem in the ignition process, the monitoring circuit has been improved on the design. A large number of tests showed that the improved monitoring circuit can run reliably. In addition, the safe ignition for the rocket engine can be realized by the application of it.

articleTitle: Electron Theory Research on Biphasic Ceramics of Al2O3/TiB2
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, the valence electron structures of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, TiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and Fe in double phase ceramic coating were calculated and analyzed with EET. The result indicated that the Valence electron density in some plane was continuous. The theoretical value fits the experimental value well. All of this showed that this ceramic coating could be prepared successfully.

articleTitle: Energy Saving and Influencing Factors Analysis for a New Kind Coal Slime Drying System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces a new type of drying slime technology - solar drying slurry technology, And analysis the effect of drying coal slime from the nature of the slime, dry air, drying equipment, according to the theoretical analysis of the impact of the factors, The suggest can be obtained to enhance the drying efficiency of slime.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of Transient Temperatures and Stresses Fields During Quenching 7075 Aluminum Cone-Shaped Shells
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The technological and economical pressures in manufacturing industry require an optimization of existing production processes. For this purpose, Thermal elastic-plastic constitutive equations are established to gain insight into the quenching operation of a production system. The finite element model is established to model transient 3-D temperature ad stress fields during quenching of the cone-shaped shells. The X-ray diffraction method is applied to measure the residual stresses of cone-shaped shell. And the measured residual stresses of quenched cone-shaped shell show a good agreement with those simulated by FEM. The example of FEM application in this paper offers theoretical basis and technological parameters for practical production, and makes it possible to optimize the process parameters of heat treatment of cone-shaped shells to control quality in the weapons production.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Throttle Performance Test System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The flow of air entering engine cylinders is controlled by the electronic throttle, which is an important part of automotive engines and has a direct effect on the fuel efficiency and the security of automobiles. For the demand of quality sampling, an electronic throttle performance test system, which met the manufacturers’ requirements, was designed to achieve the test of the opening performance of electronic throttle on the bases of C++ Builder, NI’s PCI-6259 data acquisition card and PID throttle controller. At present, the system has been put into use in the electronic throttle factory. Compared with original test devices, the system is of more stability and higher accuracy, furthermore, more than 40% of the test time is saved.

articleTitle: An Improved Target Immunization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Strategies for network immunization have been drawing wide interest in the area of complex networks during the past decade. The target strategy, in which degree values are used to determine vaccinating priority, has been supposed to be the most effective strategy. In many networks where large numbers of nodes exists with same degree values, the target strategy will face a problem of deciding the priorities of nodes with equal degree. This paper discussed a refined method to evaluate priority using risk-value. With risk-values, an improved target immunization strategy is proposed. Simulations under SIS model using real network dataset have proved a better efficiency for the improved strategy.

articleTitle: Study on Paper-Based Fiberboard and Vacuum Treatment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the required fiber quality and the technical conditions of manufacturing fiberboard, the technology on paper-based fiberboard manufacturing and vacuum treatment was studied. After thorough investigation, the optimum technical conditions have been gained as follows: hot pressing temperature 160°C, hot pressing time 6 min, forming pressure 11MPa and the quantity of adhesive 10 percent. After vacuum treatment by the steam jet system in conditions as chamber below 700 Pascal, temperature in chamber 80°C, treatment time two hours, the contained proportion and emission quantity of the urea formaldehyde resin meet the requirements of GBT11718-1999. In addition to this, the mechanical properties of the paper-based fiberboard are greatly improved at the same time.

articleTitle: CAM Software for Multi-axis Laser Direct Manufacturing and Re-manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Laser direct manufacturing and re-manufacturing (LDMR) is one of advanced Rapid Manufacturing (RM) techniques. For overcoming the problem of conventional three-axis RM, multi-axis machine tool or robot has been applied in RM systems recently. This paper introduces a CAM software developed on a commercial CAD/CAM platform. The CAM system automatically generates the tool paths for multi-axis LDMR by direct slicing. For process planning, neural network is used to optimize the process parameters. These tool paths and parameters are then translated into motion control commands of multi-axis machine tool by post processing. A description of the CAM software is given. Direct slicing method and neural network model are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Research on the Temperature Control Device for the Zipper-Molding Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the theory of thermal conductivity, this paper analyzes its reason contrapose this phenomenon the nylon lack of tenacity happens to crack when in the molding process. Meanwhile, this paper takes advantage of the soft ANSYS to analyze the center temperature distribution of the back mould in the molding process. The thermo-module which prevents this phenomenon from coming up, is redesigned to heat the nylon linear material plastic making in the molding screw. This module will decrease scrap page of zippers numerously.

articleTitle: Parameter Study of Transport Processes with Catalytic Reactions in Intermediate Temperature Solid Oxide Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Solid oxide fuel cell is one of most promising types of fuel cells with advantages of high efficiencies, flexibility of usable fuel types. The performance of SOFC is strongly affected by cell overall parameters, e.g., temperature, pressure, reaction rates, etc. In this work, a 3D CFD model is developed to simulate the working processes in SOFC's anode. The objective of this work is to study the effects of the parameters such as inlet temperature, permeability and pores radius on the working processes, by coupling the chemical reactions of gas- and surface-phase species based on catalyst surface coverage with the transport processes such as mass, momentum and thermal energy.

articleTitle: The Software Design of Data Acquisition Server Based on Multi-agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As the supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system become more and more distributed and complex, the job of designing data acquisition server (DAS) software is very challenging. This paper advances a new design method for data acquisition server software based on multi-agent. By using multi-agent technology, the flexible intelligent communication protocol interface and optimal load balancing policy are designed to tackle the problems of variety communication protocols and heavy network loads. It can easily add new protocol or modify protocol without any modification of the protocol interface software's source code. So, the performance such as scalability and maintainability of the DAS has been greatly improved. This method has already been implemented in the real project, and the desirable result of application in this project field proves its validity.

articleTitle: A New Method of Optimal Order Reference Set for Product Assembly Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Through analyzing the influence factors of assembly process, an evaluation index system is proposed, According to assembly precedence relationship and the parallelism characteristics of actual assembly sequence, a new algorithm-"Optimal order reference set" is proposed to calculate assembly membership degree of unit level index. Concrete application steps are verified through a case study. Analysis of the example shows that the proposed method satisfied the requirements of practical process rules and the integrity of index system. By the new method, optimal selection of geometric feasible assembly sequence is realized. This method has realistic significance to automatic assemble application.

articleTitle: The Discussion of Water-Saving Technology about Water Supply and Drainage in Building
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the present situation of building water supply and drainage, analyzing the water-saving techniques of building water supply and drainage to achieve effective utilization of water resource. The water-saving techniques mainly include reasonably limiting the pressure of water distribution points and avoiding overpressure flow, perfecting hot water supply system and reducing ineffectual cold water, adopting water-saving water-dispensing fixtures and sanitary ware, promoting the utilization of high-quality pipe and valve, and improving the current construction of fire pool as well as developing and promoting the technology of utilization of reclaimed water and rainwater.

articleTitle: Simulation of Hydrogen Production from Biomass Catalytic Gasification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this study, biomass catalytic gasification process for producing H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-rich gas was presented. The process consists of mainly two fluidized beds-a gasifier and a CaO regenerator. The objective of this research is to develop a computer model of biomass catalytic gasification. A model was developed using Aspen Plus software. The model predicted gas composition and hydrogen yield in good agreement with experimental data. In the case of CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> catalysis, the effects of operating parameters, including gasification temperature, steam to biomass ratio and CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> addition on product gas composition, and hydrogen yield were analyzed. The results showed the use of CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> has the potential to enhance the hydrogen content, and the suitable gasification temperature is at 650-700°C in this catalytic reaction. Furthermore, the hydrogen yield can reach 77.48g/kg biomass, and the highest hydrogen concentration can reach more than 70% (mol) at the optimal conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Distribution Pattern in Deep Coal-Bed Based on In-situ Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Knowing about the distribution of gas pressure in coal seam is significative to study the flow of coal seam gas, the occurrence and the change of dynamic phenomenon. An in-situ detection is used to detect the in-situ occurrence of gas in No.3 coal seam in Sihe coal mine of Jincheng Anthracite Mining Group in Shanxi province. The distribution of gas pressure around the holes and the change of the content of gas are studied abstractly, which based on the mathematical simulation of the seam gas-seepage. The results show that in-situ detection technique of coal seam gas could shorten the time of from founding the coal to starting to detect, which observably improved the accuracy of testing data, and meanwhile, made up for the deficiency of traditional detection technique in the loss of pressure at earlier stage. It is concluded that the pressure of the initial reservoir gas was about 0.3MPa, from the results of the detection of No.3 coal seam in Sihe coal mine. In order to simulate the distribution of gas pressure surrounding the drilling hole in No.3 coal seam in Sihe coal mine, the mathematical models of the seam gas-seepage were built through COMSOL numerical simulation software. From the results of simulation, the dates on the distribution of gas pressure and the content of gas were obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Accuracy of Vertical Moving Stage in Integral Stereolithography
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To build up integral SL system, a control system of vertical moving stage in the Integral SL system is established. The control system consists of small power stepper motor, movement control cards, driver of stepper motor, precision ball screw, linear guide. The motion accuracy of vertical moving stage in integral SL is an important factor which influences the building accuracy of the SL system. To elevate the building performance of the integral SL system, investigations of motion accuracy of vertical moving stage in integral SL has been conducted. According to accuracy testing method of NC machine, which is used to determine positioning and repositioning accuracy of the axes of NC machine, experiments has been carried out to test the positioning and repositioning accuracy of the vertical moving stage. The experiments results show that the positioning accuracy is 10.9um and the unidirectional repositioning accuracy is 10.8um when the vertical moving stage descends, the positioning and unidirectional repositioning accuracy is both 7.6um when the vertical moving stage ascends. The experiments results also demonstrate that the novel integral SL system has the capability of fabrication small objects with high accuracy.

articleTitle: An Optimized Target Tracing Algorithm for Intelligent Robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper we study on target tracing system for intelligent robot and propose an optimized algorithm to track the objects such as human body, which needs to detect the moving targets from the background in image sequence, and trace them by controlling theory and image processing. In the first stage, we detect the changing regions and background area through GMM(Gaussian Mixture Model). Based on the results of the first stage, we adopt Kalman filter algorithm united with Mean-Shift to keep track of the moving targets. At last, the experimental results show that our method is robust and efficient, it has theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of the Mechatronic System of a Large and Heavy Duty CNC Gear Shaper
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Kinematic accuracy of CNC gear shaper has great influence on the machining precision of gear work piece. The kinematic accuracy of CNC gear shaper is determined by coupling effects of mechanical system, control system and driving components of the gear shaper. In order to improve the kinematic accuracy of a large and heavy duty CNC gear shaper, a coupled electromechanical model of the gear shaper was set up. Based on the model, proportional gain and integral gain parameters of the control system of the gear shaper were optimized. With the optimized PI parameter, the reverse driving torque and the response time of the rotatory worktable were significantly reduced, and thus the speed and stability of the machine was improved, thereby improving the kinematic accuracy of the machine. The work in this paper is helpful to design and manufacture of machine tools.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Hydro-geochemical and Isotope Characteristics in Bangnazhang-huangcaoba Hot Spring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the analysis of Hydro-geochemical and environment isotope characteristics of Bangnazhang-huangcao dam hot spring in Yun nan province, the author think that the hot springs has the same regularity in the region, the hot springs are completely different from cold springs and surface water. At the same time, the Hydro-geochemical and environment isotope characteristics are different shows that the hot springs are relatively independent water circulation characteristics. Through the δD-δ18O relation and gas composition analysis of hot springs, point out the supply source of hot springs came from atmospheric precipitation. Through the TDS major ion content, the relationship between δD-TDS and δ18O-TDS, which shows that the increase of salt in hot springs is mainly the result from water-rock interaction.

articleTitle: Study on Nitrate-N Removal by a Catalytic Electrolysis Method in Water
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A new method for Nitrate-N removal in water has been presented in this paper, and related experiments have been carried out to study its technical characteristics. Results showed that in designed electrolysis system, Fe modified Ti substrate cathode can catalytic reduce NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N to NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N under suitable conditions. Furthermore NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N can be oxidized to N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-N in same system by supporting of Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>. Under the conditions of Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> addition quantity of 500mg/L, current density of 12 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, plate distance of 9mm, stirring intensity of 450rpm, and electrolysis time of 150min, about 94.3% NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N and 94.1% TN can be removed, even no NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N or NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N is produced. Moreover mechanism has been analyzed based on bimetal catalytic reduction and obtained results. The adsorption effect of Fe to O and reductant attacking may be considered as the major cause of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N reduction. And chlorine oxidation may be the reason of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N harmlessly removing.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Lock Devices Based on the MCP2515 CAN-Bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A control system based on the CAN-bus is designed to meet the real-time, reliable performance of the automatic lock devices. Modularization design idea is adopted. The control system consists of the main control module, the station of extracting the key teeth coding, the station of loading up billiards, down billiards, spring, the station of detecting lock, the station of sealing. Each station has a common, integrated MCP2515 CAN-bus controller circuit board. It makes the functional module be a CAN node in the CAN network, and the modules exchange data by CAN network. The result of the control system running indicated that it could meet the high speed requirement, reliable control, and easy maintainability.

articleTitle: Determining Intrinsic and Pose Parameters of Camera Based on Concentric Circles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we present that determining camera intrinsic and pose parameters based on concentric circles via planar structure, then using circular points constraint camera intrinsic parameters by linear methods. Meanwhile to obtain camera pose parameters, we employ two orthogonal vanishing points on the images and hypothesis arbitrary point on the image is corresponded to the origin of the 3D world coordinate system by computing. By means of presented approach determining camera intrinsic and pose parameters. This method neither knowledge of concentric circles massage, nor matching problem about image points. Moreover, all the calculation is linear. At the same time, because in the real man-made environment existence many concentric circles, so the method is pragmatic. Numerical simulation and real image experiment demonstrate the method not only robustness but also accuracy of this new method.

articleTitle: The Self-Sealing Mechanism for Materials and Bonded Rings for Flange Joints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The Poisson's ratio of a material indicates both its liquid behavior and its incompressibility, the greater and nearer to 0.5 the Poisson's ratio of a solid material, the better its liquid behavior and its incompressibility. The sealing task for a self-sealing ring is to fully change the medium pressure on its inner cylinder orthogonally into the sealing stress on its end face. Therefore, any soft solid ring can work as a self-energizing seal when compensated for its axial deformation under radial pressure up to the orthogonally deformating degree of a liquid with a Poisson's ratio of 0.5 by a compensation angle.

articleTitle: Character of the Stress Wave in the Butt Weld Joints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Stress wave test technique has broad prospects because of the long distance, large scale and relatively low cost. This paper studies the stress wave propagation characteristics in the butt weld joints in the case of external symmetrical impact. The stress wave propagating before and after the joints is measured by dynamic strain gauge. The results show the loss of stress wave is small. After spectrum analysis, the change of propagating stress wave can be detected.

articleTitle: The Study of Piano Tuning System Based on the TMS320 Series DSP Chip
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper describes the basic theory of piano tuning realization and its implementation of the application of the TMS320 series Digital Signal Processing (DSP) chip. On this basis, the basic idea of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms in digital signal processing is then introduced.

articleTitle: Process Design for Cold Precision Forging of Bevel Gear
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Precision forging is defined as a near net-shape forging operation which generates high quality parts concerning surface quality and dimensional accuracy. In particular gears offer a wide application field for the precision forging technology. Advantages like shortened production cycles achieved by eliminating machining operations and the saving of raw material contribute to the ongoing cost-saving trend in the industry. This article describes the adopted methods and the precision forging process of the bevel gear. 3D FEM model of the precision forging process of bevel gear was established. The forming laws, material plastic behavior, changed geometries and the qualities of the gears are explored by finite element simulation. Completely filled gear teeth were obtained using a lower forging load by the designed process which is the effective forging process for manufacturing of bevel gear. The design process for bevel gear has to be purpose-built to consider the distinctions of this precision forging technique.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Solar Drying of Lignite
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this study, a thin-layer solar drying experiment was conducted outdoors to investigate characteristics of solar drying of lignite. The maximum temperature of lignite in the solar dryer reached 87 □ in 140 minutes when the hourly average of solar radiation intensity was about 950 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Meanwhile the moisture content of lignite was reduced to 1.38 % from 23.08%. To examine the feasibility of using a solar drier for drying lignite, another drying experiment has been conducted under two different modes (a) solar drying of lignite (b) open sun drying of lignite. The useful temperature rise of about 25 □ was achieved in the solar dryer, which increased the drying potential of lignite by 6.21%. Moreover, influencing factors in solar drying of lignite, including the effect of solar radiation intensity, the particle size of lignite and the thickness of lignite layer, were investigated. The results indicated that strong solar radiation, small lignite particles and thin lignite layer are good for the increase of the performance of solar drying of lignite.

articleTitle: Developmental Toxicity of Triadimefon in Embryo-Larval Stages of Zebrafish
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Triadimefon, a triazole fungicide, has been widely detected in the environment, but few studies have assessed its effect on aquatic organisms. The present study evaluated the effect of triadimefon in embryo-larval stages of zebra fish. Zebra fish embryos exhibited teratogenic effects of bent spine, uninflated swim bladder and other malformations after exposure to various triadimefon concentrations (0-4.0 μg/mL) from 6 to 120 h post-fertilization (hpf). We observed the loco motor activity namely spontaneous movement in embryos and swimming activity in larvae to assess the neurotoxicity. This is the first study to detection the neurotoxicity and teratogenic of triadimefon in zebra fish. We also inferred the spontaneous movement was related to the hatching rate and the potential course of the uninflated swim bladder. The results further the understanding of the toxicity of triadimefon to aquatic organisms and suggest the need for additional research to identify the mode of triadimefon toxicity.

articleTitle: Distribution and Mobility of Heavy Metals in Soil of Sewage Irrigation Area in Pearl River Delta, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The research reveals the mobility and distribution of heavy metals (Cd, Cu, Zn, Mn, Ni, and Cr) in soil of sewage irrigation area in Pearl River Delta. Samples were collected from topsoil (0-10cm) and subsoil (30-40cm), and the total concentration and available concentration of heavy metals were extracted by HNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-HF-HClO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and DTPA respectively. The mean total concentrations for all of the heavy metals in topsoil are higher than that in subsoil in study area. Cd has the best mobility in soil of study area due to soil has lower retention for Cd than for other metals, while Ni has the poorest mobility in soil of study area. The total concentrations of Zn, Cu and Cd decrease with the depth of soil profile, while the total concentrations of Cr and Ni have little change with the depth of soil profile, only the total concentration of Mn has a little decrease at first and then increased rapidly with the depth of soil profile.

articleTitle: Underground Backfilling Technology for Waste Dump Disposal in Coal Mining District
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: China is one of the few countries over the world which uses coal as the main energy, and its coal production has become more than one third of the world. To cope with the serious problems caused by the coal exploitation such as waste discharge, environment destruction and land occupation, harmonious development of coal mines green exploitation and ecological environment has been suggested by Chinese scholars. This paper systematically introduces the general framework of underground backfilling technology for waste dumps disposal. The surface waste crushing and conveyance system, deep vertical feeding system used to convey waste from surface to underground, underground conveyance system, backfilling system layout of fully mechanized long wall mining with solid material backfilling technology, key equipment and backfill technics were researched and developed. The engineering application indicates: using the fully mechanized mining with solid material backfilling technology can dispose waste 30,000 to 50,000 tons while exploit coal 50,000 to 80,000 tons per month, so that a higher production, more effective recovery and environmental benefits will be realized.

Author Keywords: Fully mechanized longwall solid material backfilling mining

articleTitle: Construction of Regional Sustainable Energy Development Evaluation Indicator System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Sustainable energy development evaluation can help the government ascertain the top-priority problem in the process of sustainable energy development and meanwhile, it offers effective information to the decision makers and public. The screening of sustainable energy development evaluation indicators and the construction of indicator system are the important precondition for sustainable energy development evaluation. This paper initially establishes an integrative index system which combines such issues as energy, economics and environment. This system can support national strategy of natural resource exploitation to reach four goals, namely, the economic efficiency, energy efficiency, energy conservation and environmental protection, so that the government can carry out sustainable energy development in the policy planning and practice. Moreover, the system takes into account the science factor and energy investment factor, giving high priority to energy security.

articleTitle: Control System Research for Field Irrigation Energy Conservation Saving Water Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The pricinple of field irrigation energy conservation and saving water integration control system is introduced in this paper. The low pressure electrical energy reactive compensation control and the management integration of IC card prepaid multi-user three-phase watt-hour meter is realized in the system. The energy conservation control using the low pressure electrical energy reactive compensation, prepaid multi-user three-phase watt-hour meter is used to realize saving water management, who inserts the card who irrigates. The design of hardware circuit and software flow, and experiment results are presented in detail. The results of testing and production in Zibo Billion Electron Co., Ltd show that the design technique of integration control system is novel, and the system has the characteristics of control efficiency by reactive compensation, accurate measurement of electrical energy, flexible power consumption management with IC card prepaid multi-user, saving water and low cost, and so on. Therefore, it is especially suitable for power consumption management in rural well irrigation.

articleTitle: Study of a New Type High Power Motor Intelligent Soft Start Controller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In response to industry power motor cannot directly starting and stopping issues, a new type intelligent design of soft starter is proposed in this paper. Intelligent soft starter design principles based on 89LV52 single chip is articulated. The hardware circuit design, software flow design and test data analysis are given in details. By producting in Zibo Galaxy high-technology development co., Ltd. it shows that this smart soft starter has the characteristics which are flexible parameter setting, intuitive liquid crystal display, diverse starting way, precise current limiting protection, accurate protection of lack phase, low-cost. So it has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Based on ADAMS Optimal Design of ATV Motorcycle for Gradeability and Shock Absorption Property
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For the existing ATV motorcycle's low grade ability and poor smoothness, the optimal design of the ATV motorcycle has been added corresponding constraints for grade ability and damping characteristic was conducted by Virtual Prototyping Technology in ADAMS. The results show that the grade ability improves from 30% to 60% after the parameter design for transmission ratio of gearbox at I gear. The root-mean-square value of the total weighted acceleration is reduced 15.96% by optimal design to damping property of front and back suspension at the 3-axial direction, it improves the smoothness and driving safety of automobiles, and for similar study provides a reference of study methods.

articleTitle: Kinetic Study on High Temperature Oxidation of CO/H2/Cl2 Mixture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The kinetic mechanism of CO/H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Cl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture oxidation is an important subsystem of chlorinated waste combustion chemistry. A new kinetic model is constructed and validated by the data from experiments, in which this system was studied in an atmospheric pressure flow reactor to investigate the influence of chlorine content and reaction temperature on CO conversion. The inhibition mechanism is discussed with sensitivity analysis and rate of productivity analysis. The results indicate that CO oxidation is inhibited by chlorine. CO conversion varies inversely with the chlorine to hydrogen mole ratio of the inlet mixture and increases with temperature. The HCl formation process and the reaction HCl+OH=Cl+H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O decrease the OH concentration in the reaction zone and lead to low CO conversion. The new model predicts HCl concentration relatively well. The reaction H+O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>=HO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> shows inhibition effect on both CO conversion and HCl formation. Increasing reaction temperature leads to higher OH concentration in the reactor and larger rate of the reaction CO+OH=CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>+H, which abates the inhibition effect of chlorine on CO oxidation.

articleTitle: A Systematic Method for Identifying Contradiction of Casting Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ), one of the most important innovation theories, was inadequate to identifying contradiction. Some researches had been successfully conducted to address the issue. However, these research results focused on conceptual design which was a type of single factor problem, rather than casting process optimization which was a type of multiple factors problem. Starting from systematic thinking, this work at first time proposed the systematic method for identifying contradiction of casting process, which enhanced the conversion capability from specific problem to standard problem whilst improved the feasibility of TRIZ. This method was validated by optimizing casting process of the intake manifold. The case study showed that the integration of the systematic method and solving tools of TRIZ increased the efficiency of casting process optimization.

articleTitle: Advanced Information-Based Remanufacturing Technology and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the introduction of remanufacturing and advanced remanufacturing related concept, this paper expounds the concepts, characteristics and application of the virtual remanufacturing, flexible remanufacturing, informationization remanufacturing upgrade and group remanufacture, which will play an important role to promote the development of advanced remanufacturing system.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Characteristics of a Hydraulic Hammer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Hydraulic hammers are used widely now in construction fields such as road, civil engineering, port, and mines. How to design them optimally, and how to control their working and improve working efficiency are interested to many researchers and manufacturers. The dynamic characteristics of them will affect their performance and working efficiency. To investigate these problems and to improve efficiency of their analysis, the study is done based on the software ADAMS. According to working principle of a hydraulic hammer, a dynamic model of hydraulic system coupling with mechanical system is established in ADAMS/Hydraulics here. Some important and interesting phenomena, and especially its dynamic characteristics are found by study of piston motion, oil flow and accumulator pressure in the hydraulic system, and some important working parameters affecting the normal working of the hydraulic system are also found, which can be used to guide optimal design of hydraulic hammers.

articleTitle: The Research of 7000 m Deep-Ocean Rock Drill
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The 7000 m deep-ocean rock drill is an important equipment of prospect for ocean mineral resource. It is made up of orientation outfit, turning outfit, pushing outfit, drill tool, framework, control system and safeguard system, etc. The main parameters are accounted, and the basic structure, function, working principle and technical parameters of the 7000 m deep-ocean rock drill are introduced in this paper. The key technical difficulty of drill tool manufacture, tiny landform adaptability, safeguard system, the control of low force when chisel in, the control of weight with whole machine are resolved.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of NOx Emission in a Rotary Kiln During Coal Combustion and Co-combustion of Coal and Natural Gas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Numerical simulation of NOx emission in a rotary kiln was carried out. In order to reduce NOx emission, the cases of coal combustion and co-combustion of coal and natural gas were compared. The gas phase is expressed with two-equation model, while the combustion with non-premixed model and the radiation with P-1 radiation model, and the NOx emission with the NOx model. The results show that, the NOx density distribution of coal combustion has a special zone with the highest NOx density, according to its high temperature zone. Furthermore, the NOx emission amount of co-combustion is lower than that of coal combustion alone.

articleTitle: Research on Treating Oilfield Injection Water with the New Adsorbent NSUL-1
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper was about absorption characteristics of the new absorbent NSUL-1, which used for treating oilfield injection water. We studied the materials dosage, the adsorption time, pH values, adsorption temperature and other factors affected on adsorption property of NSUL-1, results showed that: when the material dosage was 4.0 g/L, adsorption time was 8h, the oil removal rate reached up to 92%. The reaction temperature of 30°C, pH of 7 were the optimal conditions, with the initial concentration of lOOmg/L of oil field injection water, its oil removal rate reached up to 98%. By studying on NSUL-1 adsorption isotherms and adsorption dynamics, results described that adsorption process of oilfield injection water treated by NSUL-1 coincided with the Freundlich equation, and the adsorption process followed pseudo-first-order dynamics adsorption model, namely the adsorption process was a physical adsorption and the reaction rate was proportional to the concentration of crude oil in wastewater.

articleTitle: Volumetric Mass Transfer Coefficients of Dilute SO2 Absorption into Sodium Alkali Solution in Packed Column
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to investigate the characteristics of the reaction between SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in flue gas and Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, the effective ingredient in absorption solution during the process of sodium alkali FGD. The volumetric overall mass transfer coefficient (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>a) for SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> removal from flue gas into aqueous solution of Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was studied in a packing column with PP rosette packing. The K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>a value was evaluated over ranges of main operating variables, the concentration of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in inlet gas, gas flow rate, the liquid sprayed density and Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> concentration in solution. And the experimental results indicate that the effect of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration in inlet gas,gas flow rate and liquid sprayed density on K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>a is significant. K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>a could be improved by increasing gas flow rate and liquid sprayed density, and by decreasing SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration in inlet gas. The concentration of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> in absorbent has no significant impact on K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>a.

articleTitle: An Advanced Velocity Profiles Optimizes Approach for CNC Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Making the CNC machine tools perform efficiently and smoothly, there are many techniques for the acceleration and deceleration of computer numerical control machine tools. Though the simple trapezoidal speed planning is the popular way, it has some shortcomings can not be avoided. Indeed the other advanced methods can overcome it, but the more complicated problems will come with it. This paper proposes an advanced approach for improving the velocity profiles, constraining the jerk, further smoothing the trajectories planning. According to the original velocity profiles, using the proposed algorithm, dividing the whole velocity profiles into many small parts. While the big trapezoidal speed planning will be used to fit the small parts.

articleTitle: Magnetic Memory Signals on Surface Defect of Ferromagnetic Specimen under Plastic Deformation Condition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The distribution of surface metal magnetic memory (MMM) signals on flat-plate specimens of ferromagnetic materials has been investigated for three types of Q235, 45 steel and T10. Defects were made on the latter two materials in order to obtain concerned signals using magnetic memory sensor at different state of plastic deformation. Stress was calculated using finite element method under plastic strain condition. According to the theory of magnetic materials and magnetic memory effect, a strong correlation was found between the signals and stress.

articleTitle: The Research of Affecting Factors of Bio-fuel High Dense Shaping at Room Temperature Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: There are factors which involve with pressure and moisture content in the orthogonal design for the bio-fuel high dense shaping at room temperature. Make use of SPSS to carry out ANOVA analysis and Range analysis which can indicate how the shaping density is influenced by the different pressure and moisture content and judge the importance of the two factors for shaping density of bio-fuel. This research may provide some design data for bio-fuel high dense shaping technology at room temperature.

Author Keywords: bio-fuel high dense shaping at room temperature

articleTitle: RTDS Based Maximal Power Point Tracking Simulation for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the control of the wind generation, the maximal power point tracking (MPPT) control plays important role in the efficiency. This paper presents the simulation results of the MPPT control with RTDS-based PMSG model. At first, it analyzes the vector-control scheme for the MTTP, which results in independent control of active and reactive power of the generator. And then, it develops the MPPT controller implemented on the rectifier and inverter based on PI control strategic.
